alt.en: A tall gray report page with a violet header and ring stands at the center of a gray floor. A dashed orange line with one packet runs to it from a teal terminal tile on the left, a dotted gray line from a log sheet in front, and a dotted violet line goes to a violet dial gauge on the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一张带紫色页眉和圆环的报告页。左侧青色终端图块经一条带数据包的橙色虚线连向它，前方日志纸由灰色点线相连，右侧紫色仪表盘由紫色点线相连。

caption.en: Illustration: a build-time test report checks a recorded trace and the tool an LLM agent selected, and feeds a test score, as the AgentTrustCI paper describes. It does not depict a tested deployment or AgentTrustCI's code, and it does not show that the checks work in production.
caption.zh: 示意图：按 AgentTrustCI 论文的描述，构建阶段测试报告检查已记录的执行轨迹和大语言模型智能体所选的工具，并给出测试得分。图中并非经过测试的实际部署，也不是 AgentTrustCI 的代码，不表明这些检查在生产环境中有效。
